finding.title: Although there is no direct OS command execution in this code, the use of hardcoded IP addresses and port numbers can be a concern if this code is part of a larger application that might execute commands based on user input or configuration files.

Similar to CWE-78, this code does not directly execute OS commands, but the use of hardcoded values can lead to security issues if this code is part of a larger application that might execute commands based on user input or configuration files.

scan_patch.message: Environment variables are untrustable input if they can be set by an attacker. They can have any content and length, and the same variable can be set more than once (CWE-807, CWE-20).
